lead_raw_text:
The structure of NaCeN crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing six atoms—Na₂Ce₂N₂—distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ce and Na each adopt octahedral environments with six geometric neighbors, while N exhibits a tetrahedral environment with four neighbors (one Ce and three Na). The octahedra share corners and edges with neighboring Ce and Na polyhedra, while N tetrahedra share corners with Ce octahedra, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
